timeline: Before Martians wiped out London on paper in his famous novel, one empire destroyed an entire island population in Tasmania.
but did you know H.G. Wells
began writing this alien invasion story back in 1895?
What inspired his story of Martians wiping out humanity?
Was it Victorian fears of space meteors?
Or Jules Verne's popular tales of space travel?
While Verne inspired the space cylinders, the plot's core came from somewhere far darker.
Wells revealed his true inspiration was European colonisation,
specifically its catastrophic impact on Aboriginal Tasmanians.
Earth suffered the exact fate humans inflicted on others.
